primitives.name: Seasonal Persistence Correlation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Method: season-level mean aggregated; Spearman r between t and t+1 aligned by season shift.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\rho_{t,t+1}': 'dimensionless Spearman rank correlation coefficient', '\\bar{x}_t': 'season-level mean statistic at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: Data is temporally aligned by season shift; metric is stationary over seasons.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Low correlation (r < 0.5) indicates instability and reduced predictive value.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic forecasting kernel where persistent stats inform belief updates in Bayesian models.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation coefficient ρ between consecutive season means.

primitives.name: QBR Team Persistence
primitives.verbatim_quote: Year-over-year TEAM persistence: mean season QBR t vs t+1 aligned by season shift; same-season QBR vs point-margin uses pbp score_differential_post averaged per team-season.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\rho_{\\text{QBR}, \\text{t,t+1}}': 'Spearman correlation of QBR across seasons', '\\text{QBR}_t': 'Team-level Quarterback Rating at time t'}
primitives.assumptions: QBR is season-aggregated and temporally aligned; regression to mean applies.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Persistence below threshold implies low reliability for forecasting future performance.

layer2.mapping: Used in GSE to derive team strength evolution and predict match outcomes via temporal consistency checks.
layer2.telemetry: Spearman correlation of QBR values across consecutive seasons.

primitives.name: QBR vs Point-Margin Correlation
primitives.verbatim_quote: - QBR vs point-margin: Pearson r = 0.7829, Spearman ρ = 0.7692 (n=90 pairs).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\rho_{\\text{QBR}, \\text{margin}}': 'Spearman correlation between QBR and game margin', '\\text{score differential}': 'point margin per team-season'}
primitives.assumptions: Game outcome is influenced by quarterback performance; linear relationship assumed within bounds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: High correlation suggests strong association but not causation; risk of overfitting without cross-validation.

layer2.mapping: In GSI, used to calibrate confidence intervals for QBR-based forecasts against actual game margins.
layer2.telemetry: Spearman correlation between QBR and score differential.
